sentences.en: I can see some boats far away from the shore.
sentences.zh: 我能看到远处有一些船。

sentences.en: The boat was tied to the shore by a cable.
sentences.zh: 这艘船被缆绳系在岸边。

sentences.en: They reported the ship to be ten kilometers from shore.
sentences.zh: 他们报告说船只距离海岸有十公里。

senses.zh: 海滨；沿海国家（或地区）；支柱；涨潮线与落潮线之间的地带
用支柱撑住；支撑，使稳住；帮助，支持
